scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{let f=fs.readFileSync('node_modules/rollup/dist/native.js','utf8');if(!f.includes('wasm-node/dist/native.js')){f=f.replace(/return require\(id\);[\s\S]*?throw error;\s*\}/, 'return require(id);}catch(e){try{return require(\'@rollup/wasm-node/dist/native.js\');}catch(err){throw e;}}');fs.writeFileSync('node_modules/rollup/dist/native.js',f);console.log('Applied Rollup WASM compatibility patch.');}}catch(e){}"
